name: Rune of Ascension Pouch payout and cache reward delivery (#4506, #4509)
contract: A Rune of Ascension Pouch is consumed once and pays the amount its own name states into the Currency tab (Rune of Ascension, item 375250). A Prestigious Cache is consumed once at max level and replaces itself in the bags with exactly one reward its content pool offers the opener; below max level it is refused and stays in the bags. A Callboard Cache carries ITEM_FLAG_HAS_LOOT, so it is right-clicked into CMSG_OPEN_ITEM rather than used: the open has to spend it once and replace it with exactly one reward, and no loot window may be left behind. A cache only ever pays from its own content: a Heroic Dungeon Cache pays heroic dungeon gear and no mythic or raid gear, a Zul'Gurub Cache pays Zul'Gurub gear, and a Burning Crusade raid cache pays that raid's own loot. A generic Callboard Cache names no content of its own and has to resolve to a released tier from the opener's own average item level, and a generic Prestigious Cache grants the most recent released one. No pool may hold a Heroic, Mythic or Ascended copy of an item, and no reward a cache pays may be one: a raid cache pays the normal row of its own raid's loot, so a Zul'Gurub Cache never pays a Naxxramas item and no cache pays a difficulty copy of the gear it names. No pool may hold an item Ascension retired either, because a cache that pays one hands over an item whose own text says it is no longer a reward. A raid cache carries the raid's own loot table, so the bracers Blackwing Lair drops, the Zul'Gurub weapons, the Eye of Divinity and the Arcanite Ripper are all in the pools the raid caches own.
